# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Data

Download the required tables and save it in a folder data/analysisSV34. The data can be found on [google drive](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1w5dl4QCyou4eIPccrZhA4jfqr0Ejmgtw?usp=drive_link).

```{r}
snapshot_dir <- here::here(
 "100_reporting", "data", "analysisSV34"
)

gw_fieldwork <- readRDS(file.path(snapshot_dir, "gw_fieldwork.rds"))
gw_domains <- readRDS(file.path(snapshot_dir, "gw_domains.rds"))
surf_fieldwork <- readRDS(file.path(snapshot_dir, "surf_fieldwork.rds"))
```

# Used queries

Here you can see the queries used to create the required tables.

gw_fieldwork

```         
WITH sampling_visits AS  (
  SELECT 
  SV.location_id
  , SV.sampleunit_id
  , SV.visit_done
  , SV.date_visit
  , SV.project_code
  , CASE 
  WHEN SV.recipient_code = '26-08679' THEN '26-008679' 
  ELSE SV.recipient_code 
  END as recipient_code
  FROM  "inbound"."SamplingVisits" SV
  INNER JOIN "outbound"."FieldCalendars" FC
  ON SV.fieldcalendar_id = FC.fieldcalendar_id
  WHERE NOT SV.issues
  AND SV.visit_done
  AND NOT FC.excluded
)

SELECT 
ST_AsText(LOC.wkb_geometry) AS wkb_geometry
, LOC.location_id
, LOC.grts_address
, IV.stratum
, IV.sampleunit_id
, IV.date_visit as installation_date
, SV.date_visit as sampling_date
, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(SV.visit_done as INT)), 0) as nr_visits
, TRUE AS is_installed
, CASE WHEN SUM(CAST(SV.visit_done as INT)) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_sampled
, IV.watina_code_used_1_peilbuis
, IV.watina_code_used_2_piezometer
, SV.project_code
, SV.recipient_code
FROM "metadata"."Locations" LOC
INNER JOIN "inbound"."InstallationVisits" IV
ON LOC.location_id = IV.location_id AND LOC.grts_address = IV.grts_address
INNER JOIN "outbound"."FieldCalendars" FC
ON IV.fieldcalendar_id = FC.fieldcalendar_id
LEFT JOIN sampling_visits SV
ON IV.location_id = SV.location_id AND IV.sampleunit_id = SV.sampleunit_id
WHERE NOT IV.issues
AND IV.visit_done
AND NOT FC.excluded
GROUP BY 
LOC.wkb_geometry
, LOC.location_id
, LOC.grts_address
, IV.stratum
, IV.sampleunit_id
, IV.date_visit
, SV.date_visit
, IV.watina_code_used_1_peilbuis
, IV.watina_code_used_2_piezometer
, SV.project_code
, SV.recipient_code
ORDER BY is_sampled
```

gw_domains

```         
SELECT 
    DISTINCT grts_address, domain_part,
    CASE 
        WHEN domain_part = 'BE2100015' THEN 'Kalmthoutse Heide'
        WHEN domain_part = 'BE2100024' THEN 'Turnhouts Vennengebied'
        WHEN domain_part = 'BE2200028' THEN 'Mechelse Heide'
        WHEN domain_part = 'BE2200035' THEN 'Voerstreek'
        WHEN domain_part = 'BE2200039' THEN 'De Maten'
        WHEN domain_part = 'Flanders_remainder' THEN 'Overig Vlaanderen'
        WHEN domain_part = 'SAC_network_remainder' THEN 'Overig SBZ-H'
        ELSE domain_part
    END AS domain_name
FROM "outbound"."SampleUnits"
WHERE schemes = 'GW_03.3'
AND domain_part IS NOT NULL
```

surf_fieldwork

```         
SELECT 
  ST_AsText(LOC.wkb_geometry) AS wkb_geometry
  , LOC.grts_address
  , LV.sampleunit_id
  , LV.stratum
  , LV.date_start
  , LV.date_visit
  , LV.notes
  , sampling_done
FROM "metadata"."Locations" LOC
INNER JOIN "inbound"."VisitsUnnested" LV
ON LOC.location_id = LV.location_id AND LOC.grts_address = LV.grts_address
INNER JOIN "outbound"."FieldCalendars" FC
ON LV.visit_id = FC.visit_id AND LV.fieldcalendar_id = FC.fieldcalendar_id
WHERE NOT LV.issues
AND LV.visit_done
AND NOT FC.excluded
ORDER BY grts_address, stratum
```

# Transformations

Add domain info to the groundwater table.

```{r}
gw_fieldwork <- gw_fieldwork |> 
  inner_join(
    gw_domains,
    by = "grts_address"
  )
```

Function to aggregate the data. Depending on the **scheme** extra summaries are calculated (e.g.: for groundwater the amount of 'peilpbuizen' and 'piëzometers' is calculated). With the **group_by** argument you can decide if the summary should be calculated over a group. The **date_filter** can be used to filter out dates (the date_filter is used as 'up to including').

```{r}
calculate_count <- function(table, scheme = c("gw", "surf"), group_by = NULL, date_filter = NULL) {
  scheme <- match.arg(scheme)
  
  # Select date column based on scheme
  date_col <- if (scheme == "surf") "date_visit" else "installation_date"
  
  # Apply date filter if provided
  if (!is.null(date_filter)) {
    table <- table |>
      filter(.data[[date_col]] <= date_filter)
  }
  
  # Apply grouping if group_by variable is provided
  if (!is.null(group_by)) {
    table <- table |>
      group_by(across(all_of(group_by)))
  }
  
  table |>
    summarise(
      nr = n(),
      nr_sample_units = n_distinct(sampleunit_id),
      nr_locations = n_distinct(grts_address),
      nr_piezometers = if (scheme == "gw") n_distinct(watina_code_used_2_piezometer, na.rm = TRUE),
      nr_peilbuizen = if (scheme == "gw") n_distinct(watina_code_used_1_peilbuis, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}
```

# Output

```{r}
calculate_count(gw_fieldwork, scheme = "gw", date_filter = "2025-12-31")
```

```{r}
calculate_count(gw_fieldwork,  scheme = "gw")
```

```{r}
calculate_count(gw_fieldwork, scheme = "gw", group_by = "domain_name", date_filter = "2025-12-31")
```

```{r}
calculate_count(gw_fieldwork, scheme = "gw", group_by = "domain_name")
```

```{r}
calculate_count(surf_fieldwork, scheme = "surf", date_filter = "2025-12-31")
```

```{r}
calculate_count(surf_fieldwork, scheme = "surf")
```
